svg.title: AI-Assisted Phishing Detection Workflow
svg.desc: Flowchart showing the full email analysis pipeline from ingestion through technical and contextual analysis, AI evaluation, risk scoring, user alert, and response actions.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about email ingestion and parsing in the phishing detection system')
sendPrompt('What technical indicators does the system analyze in emails?')
sendPrompt('How does contextual and behavioral analysis work in the phishing detection system?')
sendPrompt('How does the Ollama AI model evaluate phishing indicators?')
sendPrompt('How is the risk score calculated by combining technical and AI outputs?')
sendPrompt('How does the system decide if an email is suspicious or safe?')
sendPrompt('What happens when an email is classified as safe?')
sendPrompt('How does the system alert the user about a suspected phishing email?')
sendPrompt('What options does the user have when responding to a phishing alert?')
sendPrompt('What happens when a user reports a phishing email?')
sendPrompt('How does the user dismiss a false positive in the phishing detection system?')
sendPrompt('What investigation steps can a user take after receiving a phishing alert?')
